method: All twenty literal full roots and actual connected source paths manually read from canonical Git blobs. Metadata-only packaging of explicit reviewed spans; no source parser/scanner or project execution. Baseline/current raw declarations independently pinned against survival mapping.

classification_definitions.integration: Real project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports core assertions.
classification_definitions.unit: Local validation/predicate/orchestration or synthetic provider/store/verifier feed; incidental setup alone does not qualify.
classification_definitions.mixed: Independent unit-only assertion blocks plus genuine boundary assertions within same root.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Missing/ambiguous mapping or insufficient/source-contradicted assertion path; separate from runtime UNKNOWN.

func sameLaunchProfile(a, b LaunchRequest) bool {
	return a.CreateKey == b.CreateKey && a.Node == b.Node && a.PrivateIP == b.PrivateIP && a.FaultDomain == b.FaultDomain &&
		a.Shape == b.Shape && a.WholeOCPUs == b.WholeOCPUs && a.MemoryInGBs == b.MemoryInGBs &&
		a.PlacementProfileDigest == b.PlacementProfileDigest && a.PlacementGeneration == b.PlacementGeneration &&
		a.ImageID == b.ImageID && a.BootDescriptor == b.BootDescriptor &&
		maps.Equal(a.FreeformTags, b.FreeformTags)
}

host.detail: Production orchestration runs, but actual provider and journal calls dispatch to the explicitly supplied fakes except in the three KVJournal expiry roots. Image verifiers and active workload gate remain fake in every root.

volume.detail: CreateRetainedVolume validates before effects, retrieves exact journal operations/results, checks ownership/retry age, calls injected CreateVolume, reobserves injected map data, and records its result. Only expiry roots use real journal; OCI methods always resolve to fakeProvider.

attach.detail: The unconfirmed-outcome root reaches ownedVolume; fakeJournal.IsOwnedVolume is false and returns ErrRetainedVolumeUnknown before attachment mutation.

observe.detail: Observe reads fakeProvider instances and fakeJournal ownership/bindings; image drift is withheld locally. No genuine store or provider boundary in this root.

allow.detail: Allow-list/version choice, qualification errors and held fence counters are synthetic local callbacks. No signed spec store, cryptographic receipt qualification or network call is reached.

scope.detail: fakeFencer does not implement activePlacementReader; all three scope methods immediately return at their optional-reader checks. Production signed-placement readback is not covered by these roots.

boot.detail: Boot descriptor construction, parsing/digest and exact cloud metadata comparison are local operations here.

func (f *fleet) hostBootDescriptor(request EnsureRequest, imageID string) (hostboot.Descriptor, error) {
	return hostboot.Descriptor{
		SchemaVersion:            1,
		Cell:                     strings.ToLower(string(f.config.Region)),
		Region:                   string(f.config.Region),
		Node:                     hostNode(f.config, request.CreateKey),
		Owner:                    f.config.Owner,
		FleetGeneration:          f.config.Generation,
		CreateKey:                request.CreateKey,
		ImageID:                  imageID,
		DatabaseID:               request.BootPins.DatabaseID,
		PartitionID:              request.BootPins.PartitionID,
		SeatID:                   request.BootPins.SeatID,
		HostAttempt:              request.BootPins.HostAttempt,
		IntentGeneration:         request.PlacementGeneration,
		IntentPayloadDigest:      request.BootPins.IntentPayloadDigest,
		CanonicalRosterDigest:    request.BootPins.CanonicalRosterDigest,
		ManagedHostProfileDigest: request.PlacementProfileDigest,
		RuntimeManifestDigest:    request.BootPins.RuntimeManifestDigest,
	}, nil
}

descriptor.detail: Descriptor encoding, hash, parse and identity checks are local; no signing or crypto execution was performed during review.

kv.detail: RecordIntent creates in the real JetStream KV and retry reads compare immutable intent; Unknown RecordResult gets and CAS-updates that key; GetOperation and GetResult read through KV.Get. Unknown repairOwnership returns without ownership promotion. OpenJournal provisions FileStorage. The persisted timestamp materially supports expiry holds, including host explicit readback.

journal-fixture.detail: testJournalBucket starts authenticatedJournalRuntime, calls OpenJournal on its client JetStream, and returns the real bucket. testLaunchIntent constructs the exact host descriptor before storing old intent.

authenticated-fixture.detail: Builds test JWT/mTLS files; calls natscell.Start for embedded broker, applies cell claim, opens bridge, then clears Embedded and starts a real client at broker.URL. Client JetStream is used by the journal. No fixture code executed in this review.

nats.detail: Embedded broker uses server.NewServer/Start and file JetStream with DontListen=true; broker internal clients are in-process. The fixture second runtime has Embedded=nil and uses bridge URL plus mTLS custom dialer, nats.Connect, and real jetstream.New. Thus journal assertions use real project client/server protocol and store, not handwritten net.Pipe alone.

bridge.detail: Production bridge binds tls.Listen tcp, handshakes the external client, creates InProcessConnForAccount into actual NATS server and copies protocol bytes both ways. External TCP/mTLS plus embedded server/store supports the KV assertions; no cluster/restart/live-cloud claim follows.

qualification_limits: Three integration categories qualify only persisted intent/result age through authenticated local project NATS/JetStream journal. OCI provider, image verifier and authority fencer are fake in every root. No live OCI, signed placement authority or actual image receipt qualification is inferred.

Seventeen unit roots use fakeJournal/provider maps and counters, including synthetic response loss, retry, restart-struct and admission/version hooks. These do not establish durable recovery, live SDK service, process restart or real cell-spec fencing.
Single broker FileStorage boundary; no multi-broker quorum, restart/crash/power-loss, network partition or production durability qualification follows.
Safety/negative/no-repeat/immutable-profile/ownership/retry obligations retained for every root. No root retirement, deletion, runtime pass/fail, ledger promotion or global completion credit.
Canonical source snapshot only; mutable human checkout and successor source changes excluded.
